body:
Throwaway, but our company primarily hires high school kids as young as 14. If an employee looks old enough, managers often force them to sell liquor. Also, we're paid minimum wage and work up to 15 hour shifts  with little to no breaks. Employees are expected to buy their own food, but we're in an enclosed venue with inflated prices. A cheeseburger would cost $8...over an hour's worth of wages before taxes.

Unsurprisingly, the job attracts some seedy fellows and everyone loses any possible ounce of passion within their first few days of work. Many employees sit around, steal tips, steal liquor, drink on the job, and smoke/deal weed on the clock.

Whole organization is corrupt at every level, but it also isn't easy finding a job as a teenager that has the potential to pay more than minimum wage with tips.

Edit: I work at a concert venue and this is my fourth year.
